faults.label: Puncture
faults.text: The tyre gave up after meeting a rogue nail.

faults.label: Flat battery
faults.text: The battery is deader than a vicar’s social life.

faults.label: Blown bulb
faults.text: One headlight now serves merely as a decorative feature.

faults.label: Wipers snapped
faults.text: The wipers retired mid-storm without giving any notice.

faults.label: Fouled spark plug
faults.text: A spark plug is fouled and refusing to apologise.

faults.label: Fan belt snapped
faults.text: The fan belt snapped with a sound like rude applause.

faults.label: Horn stuck on
faults.text: The horn stuck on and terrified the neighbourhood dogs.

faults.label: Leaky roof
faults.text: The roof leaks so much the car has opinions on weather.

faults.label: Clutch burnt out
faults.text: The clutch burnt out and now smells of regret.

faults.label: Radiator leak
faults.text: The radiator leaks like a colander full of coolant.

faults.label: Brakes gave up
faults.text: The brakes gave up, citing burnout and poor management.

faults.label: Alternator died
faults.text: The alternator died quietly and left everything completely uncharged.

faults.label: Exhaust fell off
faults.text: The exhaust fell off and was claimed by a badger.

faults.label: Suspension collapsed
faults.text: The suspension collapsed like a deckchair at a fete.

faults.label: Carburettor tantrum
faults.text: The carburettor had a tantrum and now sulks at junctions.

faults.label: Fuel pump packed in
faults.text: The fuel pump packed in and moved back to its mum’s.

faults.label: Gearbox exploded
faults.text: The gearbox left the car and joined a circus.

faults.label: Engine blew up
faults.text: The engine blew up spectacularly, costing the mechanic his lunch.

faults.label: Head gasket gone
faults.text: The head gasket has gone, mayonnaise now fills the engine.

faults.label: Chassis rot
faults.text: The chassis rot is so advanced it resembles antique lace.

faults.label: Differential disaster
faults.text: The differential had a disaster and scattered itself down the road.

faults.label: Wiring fire
faults.text: The wiring caught fire, providing brief but dramatic interior lighting.

faults.label: Crankshaft snapped
faults.text: The crankshaft snapped in two, which is never a good sign.

faults.label: Cylinder head cracked
faults.text: The cylinder head cracked like a biscuit dunked too long.
